nature_role: Determine whether existing public Cirsium resources can support module-specific local genealogy and ancestry inference in focal Japanese systems without reference-induced artefact.

r1b_pilot_design.sample_target: 6-10 C. sieboldii individuals spanning populations and directly scored capitulum states; phenotype labels kept blinded during first mapping-QC pass where feasible
bias_tests: phenotype-linked missingness after labels are opened
reference-specific local ancestry or local-PCA signals
r1b_pilot_design.negative_control_principle: Reference transfer is acceptable only when the biological conclusion, not merely global mapping rate, is stable across the primary congener backbones and East-Asian sequence anchor where technically comparable, and when the claimed among-reference differences exceed same-individual hap1-vs-hap2 sensitivity.

reference_internal_controls.purpose: bound same-individual reference-haplotype sensitivity; NCBI assembly comments report haplotypic inversions on chromosomes 1, 6 and 7

r1b_pilot_design.reference_metadata_boundary: NCBI accession-level reports identify 17 chromosome-scale scaffolds for both hap1 assemblies. Any prior 19-chromosome description is superseded.

GREEN_EXISTING_REFERENCE_SUFFICIENT.condition: Genome-wide ancestry and the local-history signals used for the planned Fig.3 inference are materially reference-invariant, with no phenotype-linked mapping/callability artefact.

AMBER_FOCAL_REFERENCE_REQUIRED.condition: Genome-wide ancestry is stable but window-level genealogy, haplotype block, or genotype-phenotype localization is materially reference-dependent.
AMBER_FOCAL_REFERENCE_REQUIRED.action: Build a focal C. sieboldii reference before Nature Fig.3 Tier-2 inference.
minimum_reference_plan: PacBio HiFi or equivalent long reads
gene annotation using public Cirsium transcriptomes

RED_PANGENOME_OR_GRAPH_REQUIRED.condition: Reference bias tracks major phenotype/ancestry classes or structural/haplotype inference remains unstable after a focal linear reference.
RED_PANGENOME_OR_GRAPH_REQUIRED.action: Use two or more phenotype/ancestry-divergent focal assemblies and a graph/mini-pangenome representation before combinatorial-reuse claims.

NOT_IDENTIFIABLE.condition: Pilot coverage or sample design cannot distinguish reference artefact from biological local-history signal.
NOT_IDENTIFIABLE.action: Do not open module-specific genomic-history claims; redesign pilot.

claim_boundaries: Target-capture loci from PRJNA957074 may inform broad topology and orthology but cannot by themselves establish fine local ancestry, haplotype age, recombination blocks, or structural-variant reuse.

Young-leaf transcriptomes from PRJNA1158676 and PRJNA1311153 may inform coding orthology and expressed haplotypes but cannot establish intergenic regulatory architecture or genome-wide local ancestry.
A high mapping rate to a congener does not by itself authorize local-genealogy inference.
Shared chromosome number does not establish equivalent genome architecture; same-individual genome-size/cytotype information remains required.
No focal C. sieboldii reference should be built until R1B shows that existing resources are insufficient for the intended estimand, unless an independent design need already requires it.
